source.rationale: D3 fires only when sibling-gate routed the miss through sibling-transform AND sibling-probe on an `incoming` turn. The family is deduped case-insensitively by code (srtb is the same product as SRTB), the EXACTLY-resolved code is what the 'No incoming stock (ETA) found for ...' line names, and the list is sorted has-incoming first then by code — collapsing to plain code order when nobody has any. There is NO cap and therefore NO per-sibling buttons (respond.io's button budget): numbers are typed and only Yes/No are offered. Note the exact code itself STAYS in the numbered list; it is excluded only from the 'is there anything more to offer' test.
source.repin_rationale: RE-PINNED at live df165492 (media-intake promote). Two changes to the offer text, both re-derived from the new contract rather than frozen off a run: (1) U+2014 folded to a plain hyphen (repo hard rule: no em-dash in customer output); (2) a quoted miss token now carries an entity-type suffix ` (<type>)` - resolver PRIMARY (the token's own first renderable candidate's entity_type, prettified only when snake_case/kebab), parser `hint` FALLBACK, bare when neither classifies. Candidate selection, ordering, quick_reply, last_result_set and dym_candidates are unchanged (verified: suggest_response is the ONLY field that moved).
